title: Nutty Flaky Russian San-Marzano Tomato Pastry
description: A romantic and delicious Russian-inspired pastry featuring San-Marzano tomatoes, crispy fried chicken, and a nutty crust served on a beautiful Talavera plate.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and nutmeg.
Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice-cold water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Prick the bottom of the dough with a fork to prevent it from bubbling up during baking.
Line the dough with parchment paper and fill with pie weights or dried beans.
Remove the parchment paper and pie weights or beans and return the crust to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
While the crust is baking, prepare the filling by dicing the San-Marzano tomatoes and mixing them with the chopped parsley and a pinch of salt and pepper.
When the crust is ready, fill it with the tomato mixture and top with the crispy fried chicken and chopped walnuts.
Brush the edges of the crust with the beaten egg and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Return the pastry to the oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
